faqs.q: What is a Hydraulics Inc. 90° hydraulic live swivel used for?
faqs.a: The Hydraulics Inc. 90° Hydraulic Live Swivels turn a line through 90° and let the hose or line rotate under pressure. They suit a hose that must turn with a moving arm, reel or tool, and the range covers NPTF, NPSM, JIC and SAE O-ring boss end combinations from 1/4" to 3/4".

faqs.q: Which part numbers are in the Hydraulics Inc. 90° live swivel range?
faqs.a: The range has 22 part numbers, from 9S4J4-O4 and 9S4P4-PF4 at 1/4" up to 9S8PU8-PF8 and 9S12J12-PF12. Each number is listed with both ends: 9S6J6-O6 is a 3/8" JIC male by 3/8" ORB male swivel, and 9S8J8-PF8 is a 1/2" JIC male by 1/2" NPTF female swivel.

faqs.q: How do the 90° and in-line Hydraulics Inc. live swivels differ?
faqs.a: The 90° body turns the line through a right angle while the in-line body keeps it straight, and each listing carries its own pressure rating in its size table. See the [Hydraulics Inc. In-Line Hydraulic Live Swivels](/p/hydraulics-inc-in-line-hydraulic-live-swivels) for the straight versions.

faqs.q: What sizes do the Hydraulics Inc. 90° hydraulic live swivels come in?
faqs.a: The 90° live swivels are listed at 1/4", 3/8", 1/2" and 3/4" body size, for example 9S4P4-PF4 at 1/4", 9S6P6-PF6 at 3/8", 9S8P8-PF8 at 1/2" and 9S12J12-PF12 at 3/4".

faqs.q: How do I choose the end combination on a Hydraulics Inc. 90° live swivel?
faqs.a: Choose the swivel by the thread on each end: the table lists JIC male, NPTF male and female, NPSM female union and ORB male ends. For a port-to-hose job, match the port end first, then pick the other end for your hose fitting; the [thread size and pitch reference](/blog/building-a-thread-reference-board) shows how to identify an unknown thread.

faqs.q: What pressure are the Hydraulics Inc. 90° hydraulic live swivels rated for?
faqs.a: The maker states 5,000 psi for the Hydraulics Inc. 90° Hydraulic Live Swivels, and every row in the size table carries that 5,000 psi figure. An assembly is limited by the lowest-rated part in it, so the hose, the other fitting and the port also have to carry the working pressure.

faqs.q: What are the Hydraulics Inc. 90° hydraulic live swivels made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state a body material or seal material for the Hydraulics Inc. 90° Hydraulic Live Swivels. Tell us the fluid, temperature and environment and we confirm the material and seals against the maker's data before supply.

faqs.q: What documents can I request with the Hydraulics Inc. 90° live swivels?
faqs.a: For the Hydraulics Inc. 90° Hydraulic Live Swivels we can send the quotation with the full part numbers and, where the maker issues them, test or material documents on request. The listing states no standard for the range, so name the thread type on each end when you enquire.

faqs.q: What does a Hydraulics Inc. 90° live swivel connect to?
faqs.a: Each 90° live swivel connects at one end to a hose or line fitting and at the other to a port: JIC male ends mate with a female JIC 37° swivel, NPTF ends with NPT/NPTF threads, and ORB male ends with an SAE O-ring boss port. The [JIC 37° hose fittings](/c/jic-37-hose-fittings) shelf lists matching hose ends.

faqs.q: How do I fit a Hydraulics Inc. 90° hydraulic live swivel?
faqs.a: Fit the 90° live swivel where the hose has to rotate: tighten both ends into clean mating threads and check the swivel still turns freely before pressurising. Tighten to the maker's make-up torque; the [make-up torque guide](/blog/hydraulic-fitting-make-up-torque) explains how to read a joint after the fact.

faqs.q: What is a Hydraulics Inc. in-line hydraulic live swivel used for?
faqs.a: The Hydraulics Inc. In-Line Hydraulic Live Swivels are straight live swivels that let a hose or line rotate under pressure. The range has JIC, NPTF and SAE O-ring boss ends in 13 part numbers, for hoses on rotating arms, reels or tools.

faqs.a: The range has 13 part numbers, from S6J6-JF6 and S6PF4-P4 up to S8J12-JF12 and S8PF12-P12. Each is listed with both ends: S8J8-JF8 is a 1/2" JIC male by 1/2" JIC female swivel, and S8PF8-O8 is a 1/2" NPTF female by 1/2" ORB male swivel.
